headword: {波乱万丈|はらんばんじょう}

definitions.gloss: eventful, turbulent, full of ups and downs
definitions.explanation: A four-character idiom describing a life or story full of dramatic changes, difficulties, and unexpected events.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{波乱万丈|はらんばんじょう}の{人生|じんせい}を{送|おく}った。
examples.english: She led an eventful life full of ups and downs.

examples.japanese: {波乱万丈|はらんばんじょう}な{展開|てんかい}のドラマだ。
examples.english: It's a drama with a turbulent plot.

examples.japanese: その{会社|かいしゃ}は{波乱万丈|はらんばんじょう}の{歴史|れきし}を{持|も}つ。
examples.english: That company has a turbulent history.

notes:
FOUR-CHARACTER IDIOM ({四字熟語|よじじゅくご})

LITERAL MEANING: {波乱|はらん} (turbulence, upheaval) + {万丈|ばんじょう} (ten thousand {丈|じょう} - an extremely high measure) = Waves of turbulence as high as mountains.

FORMS:
・{波乱万丈|はらんばんじょう}な＋noun (attributive)
・{波乱万丈|はらんばんじょう}の＋noun (attributive - more common)
・{波乱万丈|はらんばんじょう}だ (predicative)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{波乱万丈|はらんばんじょう}の{人生|じんせい} (an eventful life)
・{波乱万丈|はらんばんじょう}な{展開|てんかい} (turbulent developments)
・{波乱万丈|はらんばんじょう}の{生涯|しょうがい} (a turbulent lifetime)

NUANCE: Often used with a somewhat positive connotation, suggesting a life that was interesting and full of experiences, even if difficult. Frequently used for biographies, autobiographies, and dramatic narratives.

RELATED IDIOM: {波瀾万丈|はらんばんじょう} is an alternative spelling using {瀾|らん} instead of {乱|らん}.
